codes.safeSummary: The request is invalid. Update it and try again.
This action is not permitted by the active policy.
This action needs a new valid approval before it can continue.
More required input is needed before this can continue.
The configured sign-in needs to be refreshed by its owner.
The service quota is temporarily exhausted. Try again later.
The required service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
The operation did not finish before its safety deadline.
The service returned an invalid response and the result was not accepted.
The result could not be verified and was not accepted.
The referenced state is stale. Refresh the request before continuing.
Local resource pressure prevents this operation from running safely right now.
Unsafe untrusted instructions were detected and blocked.
The isolated execution boundary rejected this operation.
The external state changed. Re-check it before continuing.
The operation stopped safely because of an internal error.
The model did not answer before the time allowed. A local model may still have been loading, which takes longer on the first request; try again once it has loaded.
The model used its output budget on reasoning before answering. Choose Fast in local model settings or ask again with a larger output budget.
The local model used its output budget on reasoning before answering. Choose Fast in local model settings or increase the output budget.
The local model could not stay fully on the GPU. Choose a smaller context or model, or explicitly allow CPU fallback in local model settings.

The model request was stopped.
The operation was cancelled.
